code_name: Eco-Niwas Samhita (ENS) 2021 - Energy Conservation Building Code for Residential Buildings
authority: Bureau of Energy Efficiency (BEE), Ministry of Power, Govt of India

rules.clause: Clause 4.1.2 - Maximum Thermal Transmittance of Roof
rules.description: The maximum assembly U-value of the roof envelope must not exceed 1.20 W/m²K for Composite, Hot-Dry, and Warm-Humid climates.
rules.remediation: Add thermal insulation (e.g. 50mm Rockwool/EPS) or install a ventilated double roof.

rules.description: RETV characterizes the net thermal heat gain through the building envelope per unit wall area. Maximum permissible RETV is 15.0 W/m² for Composite and Hot-Dry climates.
rules.remediation: Reduce WWR on West/East facades, enhance wall insulation, or specify higher overhang projection factors.

rules.description: The aggregate area of operable windows/ventilators must be at least 10% of the usable floor area to promote natural cross ventilation.
rules.remediation: Increase window opening sizes or add operable ventilation louvers.

rules.description: Glazing must maintain a minimum Visible Light Transmittance (VLT) of 0.27 to ensure adequate internal daylight autonomy.
rules.remediation: Ensure high-clarity clear or Low-E spectrally selective glazing.
